title: Atlas Shopping List V1 normalized workbook evidence
$comment: Design-only closed object shapes and physical annotations. Cross-object invariants below require a separate validator; this is not an XLSX ZIP, currentness, backend-authority, or import implementation validator.

unit_display.description: Shared shoppingListUnitDisplay(controlled_unit): trimmed human-facing code, otherwise trimmed human name. Technical adoption codes, UUIDs, placeholders and control characters are rejected; no usable candidate blocks export. Hidden __unit_id remains controlled_unit.id. This presentation projection adds no database field or print-geometry change.

__location_id.description: Required hidden row-bound lineage/currentness evidence. Zero effect on School text, groups, height, wrapping, width, page breaks or print certification.

school_display.description: Presentation only: canonical School on first group row, blank on following rows, or School (tiếp) on a print continuation; never an identity key.

x-atlas-layout.schoolPresentation: School name only on the first data row, blank following rows, School (tiếp) on continuation pages; no Delivery Location/address, subgroups, merged data cells or extra School row.
x-atlas-layout.scope: generated collection of 1–7 service dates, each bound to its authoritative daily Confirmed Need batch

x-atlas-invariants: Unique __line_id; exact complete current backend line set; no name aggregation.
Each row marker equals metadata workbook_marker; it is artifact binding, not a signature or session credential.
There are 1–7 represented service dates; metadata bounds equal the first and last dates; each row date matches its containing worksheet and canonical line.
Exactly one daily_batches entry per date sheet; its batch/version/run/snapshot and every row's revision/decision and School/location/Ingredient/Unit bindings match fresh authorized evidence.
Blank visible School cells and print-only (tiếp) labels never drive identity; every row carries its own School/location/Ingredient/Unit IDs.
Delivery Location is required hidden row evidence with zero presentation effect; visible ambiguity and print certification never use Location text or identity.
Visible School, Ingredient and Unit reference labels match fresh canonical saved facts; GHI CHÚ is ignored on import.
Export requires saved/current authoritative state with no unsaved local draft; import after browser restart requires no session manifest.
Import does not overwrite an unsaved local Confirmed Need draft on a represented date.
GHI CHÚ is export-time Supplier advice and working paper only; import ignores it and Supplier projection drift alone does not stale a quantity row.
Quantity equality is exact; only real edits apply two-decimal and current Planning-step rules.
A4 portrait black-and-white staff surface; repeated date/header rows, controlled School breaks, bounded print area and used range.
Exact physical Table/meta/sheet set, no nonempty out-of-region cells, no formulas/executable parts.
No partial apply, no import-time business write, no released-state import.
Print certification covers the documented 84-character row envelope and independent field stresses, not arbitrary unbounded text or database validation.

x-atlas-print-certification.combinedMetric: Canonical School name, Ingredient, authoritative operator-facing Unit display, shortest exact quantity display and derived Supplier. Count Unicode code points including spaces within cells, excluding line breaks, blank-group suppression, continuation suffix and inter-column spacing. Delivery Location is hidden lineage only and has zero presentation effect.
x-atlas-print-certification.independentMaxima: Test row-level envelope plus isolated field stresses; do not combine independent catalog maxima unless observed domain evidence supports the combination.
x-atlas-print-certification.overflow: Outside this QA envelope needs connected-exporter overflow handling/certification or a clear export warning/block; never silently clip. No database name-length rule.
